title: Introducing the Unity Fellowship 🎮

author: Unity
description:
Introducing the Unity Fellowship 🎮

The final stretch before a game launch is where support, connections, and funding can make a meaningful impact.

That’s why we’re selecting a cohort of 10 indie Made with Unity teams and backing them on their road to launch.

Real support, not just a check:
✅ $50,000 USD cash grant to spend however you choose (No recoup. No revenue share. 100% your IP)
✅ Dedicated Unity partner help to solve technical roadblocks
✅ Marketing and launch support
✅ Industry connections 

You keep full creative control of every decision for your game and Unity provides support when and how you choose to use it. 

Your game. Your vision. Your strategy.

Are you close to launching your game? Submissions are officially open now through December 18. 

🔗Apply today: https://on.unity.com/3UMjRZ3

#Unity #UnityFellowship #IndieGames #GameDev #IndieFunding
